lead_raw_text:
The structure of MnCd3Rh crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms—Mn4Cd12Rh4—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 geometric neighbors (6 Cd, 3 Mn, 3 Rh), while Mn and Rh each have 8 Cd neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Cd 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Cd 12-vertex and Mn 8-vertex polyhedra.
